# Catalog

The generated files the public library website and Danbyte's library browser read, built by `danbyte-lib build-catalog`: `catalog.json` (this schema: one row per entry, everything a list, its filters and search need), `items/<vendor>/<slug>.json` (`#/$defs/item`: the row plus the fully merged record, for a detail page) and `vendors.json` (`#/$defs/vendors`). Asset URLs are relative to the folder holding `catalog.json`. The site never parses YAML; it builds against this versioned schema, so the repository and the site can change separately.

Schema: [`danbyte/schema/catalog.schema.json`](../../schema/catalog.schema.json) (danbyte-library/catalog/v1).

|---|---|---|---|

| `generated` | [date](#date) | yes | The build date. |
| `count` | integer (0–…) | yes |  |
| `entries` | list of [row](#row) | yes |  |

### item

`items/<vendor>/<slug>.json`: the catalog row plus the merged record (upstream + overlay, as Danbyte imports it) and the overlay's own additions.

Also takes the keys of [rowFields](#rowfields).

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `"danbyte-library/catalog/v1"` | yes |  |
| `record` | mapping | yes | The merged YAML as JSON. |
| `additions` | list of mapping |  | What the overlay added or removed, with `why`. |
